description: Pluggable modules the planner may route to. Two-week demos use mock=true implementations.

modules.name: Background Lock
modules.description: Freeze background / distant scene to a reference image.

modules.name: Camera Lock
modules.description: Disable camera move and cuts.

modules.name: Appearance Reference
modules.description: Bind character look to a front/side reference image.

modules.name: Texture / Look Edit
modules.description: Adjust material, lighting look, face cleanliness without changing motion.

modules.name: Walk Locomotion
modules.description: Generate or retrieve walking motion (HumanML3D WALK).

modules.name: Run Locomotion
modules.description: Running motion module.

modules.name: Jump Action
modules.description: Jump motion (see T001 patterns).

modules.name: Turn Action
modules.description: In-place or stepping turn.

modules.name: Idle / Stand
modules.description: Standing idle with mild expression.

modules.name: Hold Key Pose
modules.description: Hold a key pose aligned to a reference image (e.g. N2).

modules.name: Reference Pose Align
modules.description: Align root/end pose to a reference frame/image.

modules.name: Wave Gesture
modules.description: Occasional hand wave overlay on locomotion/idle.

modules.name: Bow Gesture
modules.description: Bowing gesture.

modules.name: Speed Edit
modules.description: Retarget playback / locomotion speed without regenerating semantics.

modules.name: Key Pose Edit
modules.description: Adjust held pose / hand clasp to a reference.

modules.name: Motion Local Edit
modules.description: Local motion tweak (gesture side, step count, path offset).

modules.name: Lip Sync Stub
modules.description: Mock lip-sync / mouth amplitude control for speech segments.

modules.name: Speech Stub
modules.description: Attach script metadata (Cantonese etc.); TTS left to external pipeline.

modules.name: Timeline Compose
modules.description: Stitch multi-segment actions into one clip.

modules.name: Quality Check
modules.description: Validate output against intent constraints.
